title: Baseline recipe E: ResNet18, corrupt_v4 augmentation
hypothesis: A from-scratch ResNet18 trained with a synthetic corruption (corrupt_v4) that matches test colour statistics should transfer to test.

leaderboard.note: single fold-0 model (submission_modelE.csv); not a 5-fold submission

findings: Test is harder than validation: fold-0 validation 0.651 vs public 0.519.
Hardest classes: Gymnocalycium, Anacampseros, Lagerstroemia, Ixora.
Dendrobium leonis and Cuphea were predicted about 1.5x more often than in train.
limitations: Validation corruption has no rotation; test images are rotated uniformly over 360 degrees (found later).
Public score comes from one fold model only.

evidence.code: Notebook dateraquest.ipynb (not hashed). Same augmentation module dq.py.
